vision.name: Orange Fetch Drill
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
(Orange Energetic Mastery only. Limit 1 per deck. If you control no Drills, as an action you may banish this card from your hand to search your discard pile for a Styled Drill and place it into play.)
[Continuous]: The first time an effect would cause a player to skip or pass an action during combat, destroy this Drill to cancel that effect.
(Created by Kevin Dennis, OP5 East Kai Champion)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP6 folder); landscape Drill layout; deck restriction names a specific Mastery
